dedupe_keys.name: senegal geolocated health facility consolidated list

description: The Senegal facility-list team publishes a consolidated, geolocated health-facility table at a dedicated Figshare DOI. Its own metadata lists a CSV file and CC0 rights. The describing article reports 4,685 unique facilities after matching 12,965 observations from 16 source lists; 2,423 facilities have at least one GPS coordinate. This file can seed a health-service network or emergency-access simulation at national scale. A caveat is that roughly half the listed facilities lack coordinates, and source data may be outdated or disagree on ownership and services. A modeller should retain missing-location flags and avoid inferring capacity from a facility name alone. The linked full-observation file has a separate Figshare DOI and carries source-level detail. I read the own Figshare metadata and article Data Records without downloading the table, checking individual facilities or routing patients. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
